description: This file defines the HL7InError class, which represents an error encountered during HL7 message processing within the OpenMRS system. It includes fields for error details, error type, and references to related queue items, along with annotations for persistence and auditing.

classes.name: HL7InError
classes.description: Entity class representing an HL7 message processing error, with fields for error description, detailed message, and identifiers, extending HL7QueueItem with persistence and auditing annotations.

methods.name: getHL7InErrorId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this HL7InError instance.

methods.name: setHL7InErrorId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this HL7InError.

methods.name: setErrorDetails
methods.description: Sets detailed error information, enforcing length constraints.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID, as required by OpenMRSObject interface.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID, as required by OpenMRSObject interface.
